## 🌞 Daily Streak Routine (All 7 Platforms)

### **Morning (20–30 min total)**

* **Coddy** → 1–2 puzzles (5 min)
* **Sololearn** → 1 micro-lesson or quiz (5–10 min)
* **Codedex** → check in, do 1 quest step (5–10 min)

*(This locks in streaks on the gamified platforms early in the day.)*

---

### **Midday / Afternoon (30–60 min)**

* **Codecademy** → 1 lesson/module (10–20 min)
* **DataCamp** → 1 exercise or mini-chapter (10–20 min)

*(Rotating depth—sometimes both, sometimes just one depending on energy.)*

---

### **Evening (20–45 min)**

* **freeCodeCamp** → progress on a project, even if just a few lines (10–20 min)
* **W3Schools** → look up 1 concept you touched that day and run a “Try it Yourself” (5–10 min)

*(Keeps your hands in the project-based + reference side daily.)*

## 🗓 Weekly Flavor

To avoid “Groundhog Day” vibes, you can rotate **focus themes** each day:

* **Mon/Wed/Fri** → web dev heavy (Codecademy + freeCodeCamp focus).
* **Tue/Thu/Sat** → data heavy (DataCamp + SQL/python projects).
* **Sunday** → review & playful practice (Codedex quests + Coddy streak, light FCC polish).

---

✨ In other words:

* *Touch all 7 daily for streaks (minimum = 1 small action each).*
* *Rotate which ones get the “main meal” time so you don’t get overloaded.*
